title: Answer: no account of information, which the topology of information problem takes as given

statements.text: Qualia formalism takes no position on what information is. It frames qualia research as a problem in information theory or physics, and one of its eight problems, the topology of information problem, asks how to restructure the information inside the boundary of a conscious system into a mathematical object isomorphic to its phenomenology, without defining the information itself.
